name: Real-Time Widget for Matomo
author: JRMora

sections.description:
This plugin adds a native widget to the WordPress dashboard that connects to your Matomo On-Premise installation to display vital metrics in real-time.

Unlike other plugins that use iframes (often blocked for security) or synchronous PHP requests (which slow down the admin area), this widget uses a 100% JavaScript (Client-Side) architecture.

Your WordPress server performs no requests; the browser queries your Matomo API directly.

Key Features:

  • Zero Server Impact: All processing is done in the client’s browser.
  • Pure Real-Time: Visitor counters and logs update automatically every 10 seconds.
  • Smart Hybrid Chart: Combines historical data (cached) with real-time data from the current day for total accuracy.
  • Performance Monitor: Detailed chart of load times (Network, Server, DOM…) and visit duration metrics.
  • “Black Box” Tooltips: Detailed, accessible information on hover, with visual differentiation for Searches, Downloads, Outlinks and Events.
  • Live Desktop Notifications: Get a system alert when someone visits your site or when a specific traffic threshold is reached.
  • Audio Alerts: Optional sound notification for new visits.

Copyright

This plugin bundles the following third-party resources:

    Source: https://freesound.org/people/dVidrio02/sounds/436214/

  • Chart.js v4.5.1
    Source: https://www.chartjs.org/
    License: MIT License (https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Matomo Widget and enter your Matomo API URL, Site ID, and Auth Token.
  4. Go to your Dashboard to see the new widget.
sections.changelog:
1.4.1

  • New: Support for modern social networks (Bluesky, Threads, Mastodon and X/Twitter).
  • Improvement: Integrated official high-definition SVG icons for social referrers.
  • Improvement: Added ‘t.co’ and ‘x.com’ detection for better X (Twitter) tracking.
  • Improvement: Code optimization for faster log rendering.
  • Translation: Updated strings for better internationalization support.

1.4.0

  • Fix: Renamed all functions, classes, and database options to use a unique 5-letter prefix (rtwfm_) to prevent conflicts with other plugins and comply with WordPress.org guidelines.
  • Fix: Updated all JavaScript constants and localized variables to use the new prefix.
  • Fix: Standardized text domain and internal identifiers.

1.3.0

  • Update: Bumped Chart.js to version 4.5.1 (UMD).
  • Refactor: Optimized JavaScript architecture for better performance.
  • Improvement: Semantic icons for all visitor actions (Events, Searches, Downloads).
  • Fix: Better handling of localized strings in JavaScript.

1.2.0

  • New: Added get_site_icon_url() to use the Site Icon (Favicon) in desktop alerts instead of the generic WP logo.
  • Improvement: Smart logic to handle modern browser ‘Autoplay’ policies (audio unlock via interaction).
  • Improvement: Updated test script in settings to reflect the real environment.
  • Fix: Added error handling (try/catch) in notifications to prevent the widget from crashing on mobile browsers (Illegal constructor error).

1.1.0

  • New: “Clean Uninstall” option in settings to remove the token and database configuration upon plugin deletion.
  • New: uninstall.php file to handle data cleanup.
  • Updated: Compatibility tested up to WordPress 6.9.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Support for Hybrid Charts (Chart.js).
  • Performance Monitor.
  • Visitor Log with semantic icons (Pageview, Download, Outlink, Search, Event).
